body_policy: Preserve rounded donor skin, rump and their continuous weights exactly; retain each congenital feature recipe.
scope: Explicit user correction on 2026-09-13 supersedes the former exclusion only for sparse and uneven-face Marisa. Reimu variants and bean shapes remain unchanged.

sparse_side_hair.note: Single braid on +X (hand_right) and a loose lock on -X. Sparse hair keeps one braid strand, its tie and tip, and a short loose strand; other braid cubes are omitted. Values are top, bottom and width on the scalp profile.

sparse_hat_seat.note: Sparse hair leaves the scalp bare. The hat is fitted as a separate accessory: hat, brim, bow and their bones move down until the brim underside sits brow_clearance above the brow tops, so the crown of the head goes into the hat. Replaces the former fixed 1.0 drop plus the runtime -0.5 placement offset.
